MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 42
   C. 30
   D. 21

2. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15.7

3. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 9
   C. 64
   D. 32

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 34
   B. 22
   C. 17
   D. 66

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 60
   B. 38
   C. 19
   D. 30

6. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

7. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.7
   C. 33
   D. 27.6

8. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 40.5
   D. 10

9. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

10. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 25

11. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

12. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 29

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 15
   C. 30
   D. 22

14. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

15. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

16. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

17. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 31

18. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.7
   C. 31.6
   D. 37

19. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 2

20. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

21. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

22. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 57
   C. 56
   D. 15

23. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 26

24. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 90

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
